summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Churvox Batch 5: MYOB Integration + Business-owned SMS Credits + SMS Permissions. All 18 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified for MYOB settings, invoice sync, and SMS sent_by_name display.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 for create operations (functional but non-standard REST)

passed_tests: GET /api/myob/settings returns MYOB connection settings (initially not connected)
POST /api/myob/settings saves API key and company file info (employer only)
GET /api/myob/settings after save shows connected=true with masked key (••••xxxx)
POST /api/myob/sync/{invoice_id} sets sync status to synced and generates MYOB ID (mock)
POST /api/myob/sync/{invoice_id} returns 404 for non-existent invoice
GET /api/myob/status/{invoice_id} returns sync status, MYOB ID, last sync time
POST /api/myob/webhook marks invoice as paid when given myob_id
Invoice creation adds myob_sync_status=not_synced by default
SMS history includes sent_by_name field showing who sent each message
Workers can send SMS using business credits (API returns 200)
Workers cannot buy SMS credits (API returns 403)
Workers cannot access MYOB settings (API returns 403)
Business isolation verified for SMS credits and MYOB settings
Auth /me endpoint works (regression)
Jobs CRUD works (regression)
Invoices CRUD works (regression)
SMS balance endpoint works (regression)
Jobs list endpoint works (regression)
Settings page has MYOB Integration card with API key, company file name, file ID inputs
Settings MYOB card shows Connected badge when MYOB is connected
Invoice list page shows MYOB sync badge for synced invoices (MYOB SYNCED)
Invoice detail page shows MYOB sync section with status badge and Sync to MYOB button
Invoice detail Sync to MYOB button triggers sync and updates status display
SMS page shows sent_by_name in message history (by John Worker, by Admin)
seed_data_creation: Test invoices created during API tests for MYOB sync testing. SMS credits purchased during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Churvox Batch 5 is complete. Features added: (1) MYOB Integration with settings management (GET/POST /api/myob/settings), invoice sync (POST /api/myob/sync/{id}), status tracking (GET /api/myob/status/{id}), and payment webhook (POST /api/myob/webhook). MYOB sync is MOCKED - no real MYOB API. (2) Business-owned SMS credits confirmed working with sent_by_name tracking. (3) SMS permissions: workers can send SMS via API but cannot buy credits (403). UI shows Buy Credits and Send SMS buttons only for employers. All Batch 1-4 features remain intact.

mocked_apis.myob_sync: POST /api/myob/sync/{id} - mock MYOB sync, generates fake MYOB ID (MYOB-XXXXXXXX)
mocked_apis.sms_delivery: POST /api/sms/send - mock SMS delivery, deducts 1 credit, logs to DB
